name: Jiangsu Ruitai New Energy Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Ruitai New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells lithium-ion battery materials and new chemical materials in China and internationally. The company offers main electronic chemicals, including lithium-ion battery electrolytes, lithium-ion battery electrolyte additives, supercapacitor electrolytes, and optical materials; and lithium-ion battery electrolyte products, such as power battery, energy storage battery, and consumer battery electrolytes.
